name: weather-dashboard
description: A dark, modern desktop weather app powered by Open-Meteo.
author: Mohammad (Moore) Hawwari

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,tsc,app -c blue,gray,green "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.node.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 file:dist/main/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.mts
scripts.lint: eslint . && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
